title: Microsoft 365 vs Google Workspace: Which Is Better?
dek: Microsoft 365 gives you powerful desktop apps like Excel and works best offline; Google Workspace is built for real-time collaboration in the browser. Pick Microsoft for depth, Google for teamwork. Here is the full comparison.

seo.metaDescription: Microsoft 365 vs Google Workspace compared: powerful desktop apps and offline work versus browser-first real-time collaboration. See which suits you.

richText: Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace are the two big office suites, and both are paid subscriptions that bundle email, storage, documents, and spreadsheets. The difference is philosophy: Microsoft 365 is built around powerful desktop apps that also work offline, while Google Workspace is built for the browser and real-time collaboration. Here is how to choose.

body.caption: Microsoft 365 vs Google Workspace at a glance

richText: Both change their pricing over time, so check the current plans on the official pages linked at the end before you buy.

Choose Microsoft 365 if you rely on the full power of desktop apps — especially Excel. Its advanced formulas, pivot tables, Power Query, and large-dataset performance are still ahead of the browser competition, and everything works offline. It is the natural pick for finance, data analysis, and anyone who already lives in Excel. For the spreadsheet side specifically, see our

Choose Google Workspace if collaboration and simplicity matter more than raw depth. Real-time co-editing, automatic saving, version history, and anywhere-in-the-browser access are its strengths, and there is nothing to install. It suits startups, remote teams, and anyone who shares documents constantly.

body.richText: You do not have to pick forever. Many teams standardize on one suite but keep a free account on the other for the moments it is handier — like opening a complex .xlsx someone sends.

items: Microsoft 365 is not ideal if your team collaborates on the same files all day and rarely works offline — Google's live editing is smoother there.

items.question: Is Microsoft 365 better than Google Workspace for Excel users?
items.answerRichText: Yes, if you use Excel heavily. Microsoft 365 includes the full desktop Excel, which is more powerful than Google Sheets for advanced formulas, pivot tables, and large datasets, and it works offline.

items.question: Can Google Workspace open Excel files?
items.answerRichText: Yes. Google Sheets opens and saves .xlsx files, so you can work with Excel documents in Google Workspace. Very complex macros or advanced features may not carry over perfectly.

items.question: Which is cheaper, Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace?
items.answerRichText: It depends on the plan and how many users you have, and both update their prices regularly. Compare the current tiers on the official pricing pages — for a single person, Microsoft's personal plan is often the simpler value; for teams, compare per-user business plans side by side.
